annotations.description: Failed to cast Thrill of Possibility during opponent's combat. This instant-speed card draw would have been efficient here, digging 2 cards deeper while using mana that might otherwise compete with sorcery-speed plays in their own main phase. At 20 life, taking 3 from Blighted Bat is fine either way, but using the combat window for Thrill is generally good sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out / passed priority without casting Thrill of Possibility
annotations.betterLine: Cast Thrill of Possibility discarding one of the less immediately useful cards (like Double Vision which costs 5 mana) to dig for more relevant plays while keeping mana-efficient sequencing.

annotations.description: Timed out with no creatures on board against an opponent developing threats. Missed a free land drop and the ability to deploy a creature (Concordia Pegasus 1/3 flyer) to establish board presence. With zero creatures and the opponent having Blighted Bat and Liliana's Devotee, falling further behind on tempo is devastating.
annotations.actionTaken: No response (timeout) - passed the entire precombat main phase without playing anything.
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain (land drop), then cast Concordia Pegasus for 1W to get a 1/3 flying blocker/attacker on board. This establishes board presence and provides a blocker against Blighted Bat.

annotations.description: Player passed priority in precombat main phase without playing their land drop or casting any spells, despite having a Mountain in hand and multiple castable creatures (Concordia Pegasus, Heartfire Immolator, Lightning Visionary). The opponent already has creatures on board while MiniMx Johnny has no creatures. This wastes an entire turn of development.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted a cast that was rolled back due to mana issues, then passed without taking any action — no land drop, no spells cast.
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain (land drop), then cast two 2-drop creatures such as Heartfire Immolator ({1}{R}) and Lightning Visionary ({1}{R}), or Concordia Pegasus ({1}{W}) and a red 2-drop, to start building a board presence against the opponent's developing threats.

annotations.description: Cast Liliana's Standard Bearer with no creatures having died this turn, completely wasting its powerful ETB card draw ability (X=0 cards drawn). The card's main value is its Flash ability to draw cards after your creatures die. Additionally, cast it before playing a land drop.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Liliana's Standard Bearer precombat with 0 creatures dead, drawing 0 cards and wasting its key ability.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp first, then cast Malefic Scythe (2 mana, enters with a soul counter). Hold Liliana's Standard Bearer in hand to flash in after combat or on a future turn when creatures die, getting actual card draw value from its ETB.

annotations.description: Opponent has no creatures on the battlefield. Attacking with only Blighted Bat (3 damage) instead of also attacking with Liliana's Devotee (additional 2 damage) wastes 2 free damage into an empty board. The risk of a flash blocker profitably trading with a 2/3 is very low.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Blighted Bat for 3 damage
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Blighted Bat and Liliana's Devotee for 5 total damage into the empty board

annotations.description: MiniMx Johnny passed on casting Thrill of Possibility at end of turn with 4 untapped lands and no other instant-speed plays available. They are behind on board facing multiple threats, have only 4 lands with expensive cards in hand, and have expendable cards to discard (like Double Vision at 5 mana). This wastes mana that would otherwise go unused and misses an opportunity to dig for lands or answers.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, wasting 4 mana at end of postcombat main phase with no other plays.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Thrill of Possibility discarding Double Vision (too expensive and slow for the current board state) to dig for a 5th land or removal spell, using mana that would otherwise be wasted.

annotations.description: Discarded the only additional white source (Plains) when holding Basri Ket (costs 1WW) and multiple other white spells, with only one white source on board (Thriving Heath). This makes Basri Ket essentially uncastable and severely limits ability to deploy white cards needed to stabilize from a losing board position (14 life vs 20, opponent has developed board).
annotations.betterLine: Discard Double Vision (too expensive and slow for current position) or Thrill of Possibility, keeping Plains to enable casting Basri Ket and other white spells. Having 2 white sources is critical for the WW cost on Basri Ket.

annotations.description: Equipping Malefic Scythe before playing the Swamp from hand. General best practice is to play lands before spending mana to maximize mana available at all points during the turn. If the opponent responds at instant speed to anything during this sequence, having 5 mana available instead of 4 could matter.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Malefic Scythe equip ability before playing the Swamp land
annotations.betterLine: Play the Swamp first to have 6 mana available, then equip Malefic Scythe, ending with 5 mana available - same end state but maximizing flexibility throughout the turn.

annotations.description: Equipped Malefic Scythe to Liliana's Standard Bearer (making it 5/2 ground creature) instead of Blighted Bat (which would become 4/2 with flying). With the opponent having no creatures, both can attack freely now, but the Bat's flying makes it much harder to block going forward as the opponent develops their board. Flying evasion is the most valuable trait to pair with equipment buffs.
annotations.actionTaken: Equipped Malefic Scythe to Liliana's Standard Bearer
annotations.betterLine: Equip Malefic Scythe to Blighted Bat to create a 4/2 flying threat that's much harder to block as the game progresses

annotations.description: Attempted to cast Basri Ket (costs {1}{W}{W}) with only one white source available (Thriving Heath). After the rollback, the player had no action in this priority window. Meanwhile, they have excellent plays available: Concordia Pegasus as a flying blocker against Blighted Bat, plus Heartfire Immolator or Lightning Visionary — they could deploy two creatures this turn to stabilize against a threatening opponent board.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted to cast Basri Ket but couldn't pay {W}{W}, resulting in a rollback and wasted priority window.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Concordia Pegasus ({1}{W}) to block the flying Blighted Bat, plus Heartfire Immolator ({1}{R}) or Lightning Visionary ({1}{R}) to develop the board with the remaining mana.

annotations.description: At 6 life facing a 3/1 flying Blighted Bat that no ground creature can block, MiniMx Johnny played Chandra's Pyreling (1/3 ground) instead of Concordia Pegasus (1/3 flying). The Bat threatens 3 damage per turn that Pyreling cannot intercept. Without noncombat damage sources, Pyreling's ability is irrelevant, making it strictly worse than Pegasus in this situation.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Chandra's Pyreling, a 1/3 ground creature with no relevant ability in this board state
annotations.betterLine: Cast Concordia Pegasus (1/3 flying) to block the Blighted Bat's 3 flying damage, which is the most urgent threat at 6 life. This buys critical time against the opponent's lethal flying attacks.

annotations.description: At 6 life with no creatures on board, MiniMx Johnny chose to cast Thrill of Possibility instead of deploying Concordia Pegasus as a blocker. The opponent has Blighted Bat (3/1 flying), Liliana's Devotee (2/3), and Liliana's Standard Bearer (5/2) - representing up to 10 damage next turn. Pegasus would trade with the Bat or block the Devotee, potentially saving crucial life points. Thrill digs for cards but doesn't impact the board, and at 6 life the player may be dead before using whatever they find.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Thrill of Possibility, spending 2 mana and discarding a card to draw 2
annotations.betterLine: Cast Concordia Pegasus (1W) to have a blocker for the flying Blighted Bat, then use remaining mana for another 2-drop like Lightning Visionary or Heartfire Immolator to have additional blockers

annotations.description: Cast Basri's Solidarity with zero creatures on the battlefield, meaning it puts +1/+1 counters on nothing - the spell is completely wasted. At 6 life facing lethal threats including a 3/1 flyer, every card matters.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Basri's Solidarity with no creatures in play, accomplishing nothing.
annotations.betterLine: Deploy a creature first - Concordia Pegasus (1/3 flying blocker to block Blighted Bat) or Heartfire Immolator, then potentially cast Basri's Solidarity afterward if mana permits. Could also deploy two 2-drop creatures to establish blockers against the opponent's threatening board.

annotations.description: Discarded Chandra's Pyreling (a cheap 1/3 creature that could serve as a blocker) instead of Double Vision (a 5-mana enchantment that is very unlikely to be cast given 4 lands, 6 life, and lethal pressure on board). At 6 life facing flying threats and large creatures, cheap blockers are more valuable than an expensive build-around enchantment.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Double Vision, which costs 5 mana (3RR) and is far too slow given the desperate board position at 6 life with only 4 lands.

annotations.description: Player attacked with only Blighted Bat (3/1) and Liliana's Standard Bearer (5/2) for 8 damage against an opponent at 6 life, but held back Liliana's Devotee (2/3) for no reason. While 8 damage is lethal if uncontested, the opponent has 7 cards in hand and 4 untapped lands (including Mountains for burn/removal). Attacking with all three (10 total) provides critical redundancy - opponent would need to remove two attackers to survive instead of just one.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Blighted Bat and Liliana's Standard Bearer (8 damage), holding back Liliana's Devotee
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all three creatures (Blighted Bat + Liliana's Devotee + Liliana's Standard Bearer = 10 damage). This way, even if opponent removes one attacker, the remaining two still deal at least 5 damage (lethal). With only two attackers, removing the 5/2 Bearer leaves only 3 damage, and the opponent survives at 3 life.
